intl-tel-input 29.2.3
https://github.com/jackocnr/intl-tel-input/releases/tag/v29.2.3
Files: dist/css/intlTelInput.min.css, dist/js/intlTelInput.min.js, dist/js/utils.js,
       dist/img/flags.webp, dist/img/flags@2x.webp (the only flag assets the CSS references)

Arabic UI text (ar site build):
  No locale file is vendored, and none is needed. This version takes its
  interface strings through the `uiTranslations` initialiser option and resolves
  country NAMES through `countryNameLocale`, which it feeds to
  Intl.DisplayNames — so setting it to "ar" renders the whole country list in
  Arabic with no extra bundle. js/phone-input.js passes both from the shared
  locale payload (the `iti.*` keys in inc/lang/ar.php).

  The wording of the interface strings is taken verbatim from upstream
  dist/js/locale/ar.js of this same version, which ships as an ES module with a
  default export and so cannot be loaded as a plain <script>.

  Note for future upgrades: the option was named `i18n` in some versions of the
  documentation. In 29.2.3 the accepted names are `uiTranslations` and
  `countryNameLocale`; an unknown option is ignored silently, so verify the
  aria-label on the country button after any upgrade.
